lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Fábia | Lesson 19 -- The Tax That Replaces Two
lesson.grammar_point: relative clauses with that and who

listenings.text: Well, it is a big change in taxes here in Brazil. Some old taxes go away, and there are new ones, with new names. It is going to take some years, I think. And companies can get some tax back, in some cases.

It is a reform that replaces five taxes. The CBS is the tax that replaces two federal taxes. The IBS is the tax that replaces two local taxes. The change is gradual: it starts in twenty twenty-six and it ends in twenty thirty-three. And companies that pay tax on their purchases get a credit.
